title: Delhi's air 'severe' again on Fri 13 Nov 2026: average AQI 402 at 5 am (CPCB, via Outlook India and Open/News9); IIT Delhi monitor 488, ITO 455 (Scroll/CPCB, Outlook/CPCB, Open/ANI); GRAP Stage III in force across Delhi-NCR since 6 Nov (CAQM, via AIR News and The News Mill/ANI): non-essential construction and demolition halted, BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel cars barred in Delhi; Delhi schools up to Class 5 in hybrid mode (Business Today 7 Nov, Outlook India)

framing.note: Box 24.40-31.90N x 73.60-80.44E (7.5 deg tall x 6.84 deg wide = ~834 x ~667 km, 4:5 latitude-corrected at 28.2N). Requested at 1440x1800 = ~463-579 m per pixel, about 2x the 250 m MODIS true-colour native size, so the server downsamples. Cardkit crop 1152x1440 from (144,126), scaled 0.94 to 1080x1350: no enlargement. Delhi (28.6N, 77.2E) lands at about x 575, y 624 (0.46), above the headline. Himalayan foothills and snow top right; haze plume edge against clearer land lower left; logo on dark foothills (mean grey 75/255 in the logo box). Laplacian variance of the 1080x1350 crop: 235 (old VIIRS tight box: 7). The 1080x1350 and 1200x1500 renditions (Laplacian 1163/431 but needing 1.18x/1.06x enlargement at the framing tool's chosen zoom) were not used. Face screen: many renditions of 12 Nov boxes (VIIRS NOAA-20/21, MODIS Terra/Aqua) screened faces 1-2 on terrain texture and were deleted unviewed; this rendition screened 0. Focal (0.5,0.47) zoom 1.25 chosen because the framing tool's (0.5,0.475) zoom 1.18 render screened faces=1 (a 516x483 px full-frame false positive at score 0.34; that 01.jpg was overwritten without viewing).
